<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def find_b(fr, minpx=20):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and minpx<=n['pixels']<=40:
            bs=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in bs]; cs=[p[1] for p in bs]
            out.append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels']))
    return out
def find_r(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='R':
            bs=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in bs]; cs=[p[1] for p in bs]
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels'])
    return None
print("before:", find_b(current_frame), find_r(current_frame))
action(['DOWN'])
print("after1:", find_b(current_frame))
action(['DOWN'])
print("after2:", find_b(current_frame), "red:", find_r(current_frame))
print("res:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def find_b(fr, minpx=20):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:

def find_r(fr):

    return None
